user_story.i_want: the AI Buddy application to be accessible and navigable using assistive technologies
user_story.so_that: I can effectively use the tool to study without barriers.

included_flows.flow: Global UI: Navigation, Footer, Layout, Colors, Focus states
Dashboard: Main layout, File upload dropzone
Learning Interface: Flashcards (flip mechanism), Quiz (selection, feedback)

functional_requirements.fr: Keyboard navigability for all interactive elements.
Visible focus indicator for all interactive elements.
Programmatic labels for all form inputs.
Dynamic content changes announced via aria-live.

acceptance_criteria.ac: Automated Audit Pass: 0 critical/serious violations in axe-core scans.
Keyboard Navigation: Full flow navigable using only Tab, Enter, Space, Esc.
Screen Reader Support: Labels and errors announced correctly.
Interactive Components: Flashcard content and Quiz feedback accessible.

task_breakdown.task: Global Accessibility Audit & Base Fixes (Colors, Focus, Layout)
